description: Question-form terminal punctuation (Step 5). Rule en-question-form-final-mark appends a '?' to a sentence that begins with a question word or auxiliary (what/where/when/why/how/do/does/did/are/is/can/could/would/will...) but lacks a terminal question mark. Expectations encode the VERIFIED behaviour of correctWithTutorRules() on current main.
fp_risk_note: The '?' must be appended only to genuine question-initial sentences missing terminal punctuation. The negative cases stress: (1) questions that already end in '?' — re-appending would yield '??'; (2) declaratives that are NOT question-initial ('I like apples') even though they are statements; (3) declaratives that merely contain a question-trigger word mid-sentence ('The cat is black' — 'is' is not sentence-initial) must not be turned into questions. A regression that loosens the initial-word anchor would wrongly question-mark statements.

negative.notes: FP-stress (already punctuated): terminal '?' present; rule must not append a second.
FP-stress (declarative, not question-initial): must stay a statement with a period.
FP-stress (trigger word mid-sentence): 'is' is not sentence-initial, so this declarative must not become a question.

negative.input: I wonder what time it is.
negative.expectedCorrection: I wonder what time it is.
negative.notes: FP guard (embedded question): the wh-clause is embedded under 'I wonder ...'; the sentence is declarative and not wh-initial, so no '?' is appended.
FP guard (embedded question under an imperative): 'Tell me ...' is not question-initial, so no '?' is appended.
FP-lock (!305 guard): declarative-WH subject clause ('What you said' is the subject, not a question). Was a false positive before !305; the narrowed question-frame guard now leaves it unchanged.
FP-lock (!305 guard): exclamative 'How ...!', not a question. Was a false positive before !305 (rewrote the '!' to '?'); the guard now leaves it unchanged AND preserves the '!'.
FP-lock (!305 guard): embedded WH clause under a declarative ('She asked ...'); not a question-initial frame, so no '?' is appended.
FP-lock (!305 guard): exclamative 'How ...' in PERIOD form (not just the '!' form). The guard must recognize the exclamative frame regardless of terminal punctuation — no '?' appended, '.' preserved.

FP-stress (already-punctuated modal question): a genuine question that already ends in '?'; the rule must not append a second one (distinct frame from the WH 'What is your name?' already-punctuated case).
